title: K Closest Points to Origin
summary: Return the k points closest to (0, 0).
approach: Max-heap of size k keyed by squared distance; push each point and pop when size exceeds k. Quickselect gives O(n) average.
complexity: O(n log k) time, O(k) space
body: iOS link: 'show the 20 nearest stores' on a map; for large datasets use a spatial index (geohash/quad tree) instead.
